results.corrected_title: Mercor raises $750M Series D at $20bn valuation, doubling its October 2025 mark
results.corrected_summary: AI training-data marketplace Mercor announced a $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation on 10 November 2026. That is double the $10 billion valuation set by its $350 million Series C in October 2025. Nvidia, Salesforce and Zoom took part alongside Benchmark, Felicis, General Catalyst and others, and the round included an employee tender offer. No lead investor is named in the sources.
key_facts: Announced 2026-11-10: $750M Series D at a $20bn valuation, double the $10bn from the $350M Series C in October 2025
Participants include Benchmark, Felicis, General Catalyst, Nvidia, Salesforce and Zoom
No lead investor is named in the sources
The round included an employee tender offer; amount not disclosed
Mercor says it has a network of more than five million experts who train and evaluate AI models; funding is meant to expand sales beyond frontier AI labs
